prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll find and recommend specific Atlanta personal-injury firms with phone/website and explain why each is a good call. Before I put together a tailored list, a couple quick questions will help me recommend the best firms for your situation:

- Which Atlanta ZIP code or neighborhood are you closest to? (helps find attorneys familiar with local courts and hospitals)
- Were you injured? How serious (hospitalized, outpatient, soft-tissue)?
- Was the police report taken and do you know who was at fault?
- How soon did the crash happen?
- Do you prefer a large national firm, a local boutique firm, or a lawyer who will personally handle your case?
- Any language needs (Spanish, etc.) or other preferences?

If you want immediate next steps while you decide on a lawyer:
- Get medical attention right away and keep all records/receipts.
- Get the police report number and take photos of vehicles, damage, scene, injuries.
- Preserve evidence: damaged parts, clothing, dashcam footage, texts, medical bills.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other insurer or sign releases without a lawyer.
- Note witness names/contact info and your own contemporaneous notes of what happened.
- In Georgia the general personal-injury statute of limitations is 2 years from the accident date — it’s best to contact a lawyer promptly.

What I’ll include when I draft the firm list for you:
- 6–8 specific Atlanta firms with phone and website links
- Why each is a good fit for your case (trial experience, typical case size, local reputation, bilingual staff, medical lien handling, etc.)
- Which firm types to call first based on your answers above

Tell me the ZIP/neighborhood and the answers to the quick questions and I’ll assemble the specific list now. If you prefer, I can give a short starter list immediately. Which do you want?
